tone.target: bright Marshall crunch with twin-guitar bite and ringing lead sustain
tone.profile: bright Marshall crunch with twin-guitar bite and ringing lead sustain
tone.summary: A high-gain, mid-focused signal chain using a Boost pedal for rhythm tightness, followed by the UK 45 amp model to capture the Plexi crunch, paired with a Chorus or Room effect for subtle dimension and Plate reverb for sustained leads.
